name: HTML basic stub
comment: Empty stand-in for the plain HTML grammar that fenom.tmLanguage.json falls back to when text.html.derivative is not loaded. vscode-tmgrammar-snap loads only the grammars passed with -g, so without this stub it warns that the include is unresolved. It stays empty, like html-derivative.stub.tmLanguage.json, so the snapshots record only Fenom scopes.
